authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 2360.4 *udukkhala gives Sindhi ukhirī, Hindi ūkhlī and Gujarati ukhṛī mortar. Goj ūkhṛī and Hadoti ɔ̃khrī fit this contracted mortar branch, retaining vowel/nasal differences and the rhotic. Exact survey form ūkʰṛī is preserved.

assignments.Notes: CDIAL 2360.4 *udukkhala gives Sindhi ukhirī, Hindi ūkhlī and Gujarati ukhṛī mortar. Goj ūkhṛī and Hadoti ɔ̃khrī fit this contracted mortar branch, retaining vowel/nasal differences and the rhotic. Exact survey form ūkʰṛī is preserved. Joint SIL review 2026-09-14.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 10223 musala section 1 explicitly gives Lahnda mōlā and Punjabi mūhlā pestle. Goj molo/mūlo fits that contracted regional form, not the distinct muṣala branch in section 2. Exact survey form molo is preserved.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 3193 kīṭa gives Lahnda/Punjabi kīṛā insect and kīṛī ant, plus Hindi kīṛī ant. Awan kīṛa ant and Goj qiṛī are compared with this family; the ant sense and q versus k are retained as regional details. Exact survey form qiṛī is preserved.
